title: Visual Page Designer — Webflow
description: Visual web design with clean code export.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for Webflow, a visual page designer. Visual web design with clean code export. Category: User Interface and Experience Engineering.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. 3. Inputs and outputs. This class of tool takes designs and user flows and produces interfaces, prototypes, and test reports. The demonstration's input is a scenario selector (0-7); its output is the human-readable result line kept in demo.output.

4. Execution instructions. Requires Node.js 18 or later and nothing else. Save demo.program to a file, append a call such as console.log(demoMain(0, 'demo')), and run it with node. No dependencies are installed and no network is used.

5. Tests and examples. This record's demonstration scenario was executed in Node.js and its real output captured in demo.output. Re-running demoMain with the same scenario index reproduces it byte-for-byte.
